body_markdown:
*TEAM™ Contract Extends Long-Running Relationship Between the Companies*


**SCOTTSDALE, Ariz. –** **October 26, 2026 –** StandardAero, Inc. (NYSE: SARO), a leading independent pure-play provider of aerospace engine aftermarket services including engine maintenance, repair and overhaul (MRO) and engine component repair, has signed an exclusive TEAM™ engine time and material support agreement with Romanian flag carrier[TAROM S.A.](https://www.tarom.ro/) This agreement will help ensure that TAROM’s fleet of ATR 72-600 and -500 regional turboprop aircraft, powered by RTX’s[Pratt & Whitney Canada PW127M](https://standardaero.com/engines/prattwhitneycanada/pw100) engines, continue to provide the airline’s passengers with safe, reliable transportation.


Under this new agreement, StandardAero – the world’s largest independent Pratt & Whitney Canada authorized PW100 Designated Overhaul Facility (DOF) – will provide TAROM with a range of PW127M MRO services from its overhaul locations in Summerside, Canada and Gonesse, France. StandardAero has been serving the PW100 operator community for over 40 years, having been appointed as the first independent MRO provider for the engine in 1984.


Commenting on the partnership, Cristian Anghel, General Manager at TAROM said: “The continuation of this partnership is a sign of professional recognition, aimed at providing ongoing technical support for TAROM’s ATR fleet, given that this model ensures seamless and optimal strategic connections by the national airline between cities in Romania and Europe, the Middle East, and many other international destinations via the Bucharest Otopeni hub. We thank our partners at StandardAero for their support.”


“We are proud that TAROM continues to trust StandardAero with this new multi-year contract, which extends our long-running partnership with the airline,” said Tayeb Bouhassis, Sales Director – Europe, Middle East & Africa (EMEA) for StandardAero. “This is an endorsement of the quality of our PW127M support, and the StandardAero team looks forward to continuing to meet and exceed the airline’s expectations for reliable, on-time engine services over the coming years.”


With over 60 years of reliable turboprop MRO experience, StandardAero provides engine support options and recommendations that are tailored to operator’s specific needs. StandardAero’s service offering on the PW100 family includes extensive component repair support, rental engine solutions, on-site field service, and engine condition trend monitoring (ECTM) services as a CAMP Systems Designated Analysis Center (DAC).


The Romanian National Air Transport Company, TAROM, was founded in 1954 and has grown along with the development of Romanian aviation industry. TAROM operates under the authority of the Ministry of Transport and has been a member of SkyTeam Alliance since June 2010, a member of the International Air Transport Association (IATA) since 1993, and a member of the Association of European Airlines (AEA) since 2000. For more, please visit[www.tarom.ro](http://www.tarom.ro/) .


**StandardAero (stand #1-731)** will be showcasing its capabilities at MRO Europe 2026, taking place October 27–29, 2026, at RAI Amsterdam in the Netherlands.


###


**StandardAero** is a leading independent pure-play provider of aerospace engine aftermarket services for fixed- and rotary-wing aircraft, serving the commercial, military and business aviation end markets. StandardAero provides a comprehensive suite of critical, value-added aftermarket solutions, including engine maintenance, repair and overhaul, engine component repair, on-wing and field service support, asset management and engineering solutions. StandardAero is an NYSE-listed company under the ticker symbol SARO.
